exec_command_schema.note: The exposed schema has no field that enforces a distinct principal or credential boundary; the supplied runtime is unrestricted.

not_verified: Whether WSL or a Hyper-V virtual machine is configured, running, isolated, or available to the developer was not tested; command presence alone does not establish a boundary.
Credential availability was not inspected, and no credential contents were read. Their absence from developer-accessible tools or storage is unverified.
No remote host or existing server was contacted; remote isolation is unverified.
No independent reviewer environment or principal was exposed by the available task/spawn schemas; other external arrangements were not audited.
conditional_prerequisites_before_unseen_: The user must provide an independently administered reviewer principal and execution environment, not merely a new path, worktree, process, ordinary container, or untested remote.

Host-enforced controls must deny developer access to reviewer files, credentials, mounts, and any conversation or logs that could contain unseen material; controls must apply to the actual developer tools and resist alternate access paths.

The reviewer must confirm the canary exists and is readable in the protected environment. Then the actual developer exec/tool surfaces must receive an explicit authorization denial on that same canary; file-not-found, tool unavailability, or a successful read is insufficient.
Only after the deny-test and alternate-capability audit pass may unseen inputs or answers be created.
